title: PhantomLoot
body:
# PhantomLoot

- > PhantomLoot makes it possible for phantoms to steal items with configurable options:

- Save previous item on phantom death (save-previous-item): true/false
If set to "true" if the phantom steals 2 or more items from you it will drop them on death.
Otherwise, if set to "false" the phantom will only drop the last stolen item on death.

- Steal armor (steal-armor): true/false
By default this option is disabled, it makes it possible for phantoms to steal your armor or not.

- Steal second hand (steal-second-hand): true/false
By default this option is disabled, it makes it possible for phantoms to steal your offhand or not.

- Commands to enable and disable the plugin
/phantoms disable
/phantoms enable

- Support for Hexadecimal colors (#FFFFFF)

- Own translation of items in items.yml.

- Customizable messages
